title: Credential prefix at a line end before unrelated text
summary: A line ends with the SendGrid key prefix, or with the prefix and a short unrelated token, and the next line holds ordinary prose or an unrelated public encoded string.
rationale: The fragments are adjacent only by position: nothing in the input is secret material. Joining the lines gives text far shorter than the documented key and with unrelated content, so a rule that joins lines at any line end would create a false credential. This is the benign control for the reconstruction Cases.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. The provider documents the key as always 69 characters; the joined text is far shorter and holds no key material, so no value in the input is a key. The statement is length only; the control does not rest on any scanner. Synthetic, never issued: every value in the fixtures is built from the words SYNTHETIC and EXAMPLE, so none can authenticate.

sources.supports: SendGrid API keys are always 69 characters long.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
